name: Fit Check
tagline: Outfit ideas, honest photo feedback and help taming your closet
description: A daily dressing companion in three parts: outfit ideas tuned to whatever day or event is coming up, candid feedback when you send a photo of what you have on, and practical help organising the wardrobe itself so the good pieces stop disappearing into the back of the closet.
author: BryanGislason
notes: Native Grok Bot share. Third-party bot; not from xAI.
